media_recovery.notes: Recovery decisions are tested by wrapping sleep/av_read_frame/writer functions; nothing drives a real RTSP disconnect. Liveness is mp4_writer_is_recording(): 60 s initial grace, inactivity_timeout=max(45, segment_duration+15).

storage.notes: statvfs() is called directly in storage_manager.c (no injectable seam); storage_target_health.c already takes an ops table with mountinfo_path/proc_root - a ready seam for fault injection.

shutdown.notes: main.c: SHUTDOWN_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_SECONDS 900 (force-kill process group), wait_for_all_components_stopped(5), forked cleanup watchdog; PID takeover waits 120 s then SIGKILL. None asserted at process level.

stream_state.notes: 6 states (INACTIVE, STARTING, ACTIVE, STOPPING, ERROR, RECONNECTING); test_stream_state references STREAM_STATE_* once (initial INACTIVE). start_stream_with_state, stop_stream_with_state, handle_stream_error, wait_for_stream_stop(timeout_ms) and transition validity are untested.

production_files_hardcoded: src/web/api_handlers_system.c: /proc scan for light-object-detect (cmdline/status VmRSS) and /sys/fs/cgroup cpu.max / cpu.cfs_* parsing duplicated from linux_cgroup collector
src/video/go2rtc/go2rtc_process.c: 8 sites (/proc/<pid>/cmdline, /proc scan, /proc/net/tcp{,6} port owner, /proc/<pid>/fd, /proc/<pid>/stat x2, /proc/<pid>/status)
proc.notes: Telemetry collectors are sound and fixture-tested. Hard-coded parsers in api_handlers_system.c and go2rtc_process.c have no tests and duplicate collector logic.

calibration_limits.name: DEAD_RESTART_THRESHOLD_SECS
calibration_limits.use: inner RTSP thread dead before restart

calibration_limits.name: ctest TIMEOUTs
calibration_limits.value: mp4_forced_reconnect/recovery_watchdog 10 s, hls_reconnect_backoff 10 s, hls_cleanup 30 s, udt_recording 60 s, detection_io_recovery 30 s

calibration_note: These are production constants, not acceptance limits. A scenario deadline must be derived from them (e.g. recovery deadline >= DEAD_RESTART_THRESHOLD_SECS + reconnect backoff + first keyframe) and measured on the T5 target before it gates. T27-T30 must declare fixture-specific deadlines; real-time values like 300 s cooldown and 900 s shutdown watchdog need clock/sleep injection or a scheduled lane.
